purpose: Illustrative staged treatment scenes replacing temporary visuals on treatment information pages. These are not actual clinic or patient photographs. Physician biography and facility photos are excluded.

assets.prompt: Photorealistic editorial stock photograph, landscape 3:2, a fully clothed adult East Asian patient seated upright on a clinic examination chair wearing a plain beige cotton T-shirt and long trousers. A clinician in navy scrubs and medical gloves gently checks the patient's shoulder and upper back through the T-shirt with both hands, careful professional attention. Treatment preparation and physical assessment in a contemporary Korean pain clinic, warm ivory and light oak room, natural window light, clean unbranded equipment softly blurred in background. Medium-wide three-quarter side angle, patient and clinician faces mostly outside the crop. Respectful routine healthcare scene, all clothing stays on. Accurate hands and anatomy, no text or watermark.
